nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.desc: Light is short in deep valleys and in winter, so sun-warmed slopes and early snow-free ground matter for plant growth.

nodes.name: Snow and snowmelt
nodes.desc: Winter snow shapes where animals can feed, and meltwater in spring feeds alpine meadows and the park streams.

nodes.name: Rain and rivers
nodes.desc: The park drains to the Soča (Adriatic) and the Sava (Black Sea), with waterfalls, gorges and glacial lakes.

nodes.name: Limestone soil
nodes.desc: Thin, lime-rich mountain soils carry the meadows and forests; nutrients return to them through decomposers.

nodes.name: European beech
nodes.desc: A widespread forest tree in the park; its nuts are eaten by squirrels and dormice, and roe deer browse it.

nodes.name: Alpine grasses
nodes.desc: Fescue and other grasses of the alpine pastures; ibex eat mostly grass, and chamois and marmots graze meadow grasses in summer.

nodes.name: Mountain avens
nodes.desc: A mat-forming alpine plant of limestone outcrops and gravel where snow melts early.

nodes.name: Alpine chamois
nodes.desc: Grazes alpine meadows in summer and moves down into forest in winter, eating conifers and bark.

nodes.name: Alpine ibex
nodes.desc: Eats mostly grass, adding herbs in summer and dwarf shrubs in winter. Reintroduced to Slovenia in the 1890s.

nodes.name: European roe deer
nodes.desc: A small forest deer, often recorded in the park, that browses trees such as beech.

nodes.name: Red deer
nodes.desc: A large deer of the valleys and forests, and a main prey of the wolf.

nodes.name: Alpine marmot
nodes.desc: Colonial burrower of alpine meadows that eats grasses, herbs and insects and hibernates for much of the year.

nodes.name: Eurasian red squirrel
nodes.desc: A tree-dwelling seed eater that feeds on beech nuts and other forest seeds.

nodes.name: Edible dormouse
nodes.desc: A nocturnal forest rodent that eats beech nuts and other seeds, then hibernates.

nodes.name: Red fox
nodes.desc: A generalist hunter and scavenger, recorded eating marmots, squirrels, dormice and deer.

nodes.name: Beech marten
nodes.desc: A forest and village-edge predator that hunts dormice and squirrels.

nodes.name: Common raven
nodes.desc: A scavenging crow that feeds on the carcasses of deer and chamois.

nodes.name: Grey wolf
nodes.desc: Pack hunter of deer and chamois, returning to the Alps; its kills feed scavengers.

nodes.name: Golden eagle
nodes.desc: Hunts alpine pastures above the tree line, taking marmots and young ibex, and scavenges carcasses.

nodes.name: Decomposers
nodes.desc: Fungi, bacteria and soil animals return dead plants and animals to the soil.
